answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated a remarkable capacity to internalize and utilize novel information solely from contextual input, without requiring any parameter updates. This ability, referred to as in-context learning (ICL), enables LLMs to leverage a small set of input-output demonstrations to solve previously unseen tasks or adapt to new domains.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs are generated answers to questions in multiple-choice format, such as selecting the correct option (A), (B), etc., based on in-context demonstrations.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the accuracy on the test set with three different random seeds.
